plan.title: Technical Stage selection saves on eRFX draft

steps.note: Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Open the Events list to reach the saved draft.
Verify the events list is available before navigating to Drafts.
Switch to the Drafts tab containing the saved eRFX draft.
Open the first saved draft; this returns to its create screen.
Open the event configuration window from the RFQ stage control.
Confirm the Configuration for Event window opened.
Select the Technical Stage configuration option.
Save the selected Technical Stage configuration.
Verify the configuration window closes after saving.
Verify the saved configuration is reflected as a Technical Stage tab.
